source_reconciliation.supporting_evidence_scope: 90 pinned supporting paths are evidence, not additional completed candidates. The unchanged shell-lifecycle-log consumer contributes 18 validation tests only.

durable_review.preservation: Every original case decision/reason, parameter row, literal operand, generated-input row, loop domain, traversal policy, timer/mock/hook control and helper branch is embedded unchanged under explicit original fields. Final inventories, assertions, declaration mappings, registered instances and completed actions are embedded alongside them.
durable_review.domain_reference_policy: domain_census_artifact and final_domain_census_artifact identify inline ledger fields. Standalone original-domains.json and implemented-domains.json are duplicate inspection copies, not required /tmp-only dependencies.
durable_review.historical_claim_policy: Original review status, support boundaries, proposal steps, validation limits and reasons are explicitly scoped to their original review. Current status, boundaries and actions describe executed implementation validation.
durable_review.syntactic_inventory_policy: Domain source spans, registered cases, array operands, generated bytes, helper branches and runtime traversals are separate counts; inventories are not extra executed tests.

runtime.boundary: Actual logical production modules execute with controlled native/RPC endpoints, React test renderer and in-memory filesystem where recorded.

typecheck.baseline_comparison_method: Same mobile TypeScript program/config, with 50 original selected snapshots overlaid for baseline versus the final selected sources. All 50 loaded source contents were verified in each program.
typecheck.limitation: The full mobile typecheck fails on 556 pre-existing diagnostics outside the selected files. Baseline equivalence establishes no added type diagnostics; it is not a clean full typecheck.

format_and_lint.result: All 19 changed files pass focused formatting and lint; the final lint log has no diagnostics.
initial_failures_and_fixes: Added braces around renderer-cleanup loops in two files.
Removed the unused BRIDGE_ACK_INTERVAL_BYTES import after replacing the constant-ratio assertion.
format_and_lint.command_capture_limit: The focused formatter/linter log files retain tool results, not the exact complete command argument vectors.

dependencies.boundary: Mobile dependencies installed into its own node_modules; no shared node_modules symlink and no native install scripts.

mutation_validation.method: A Vite pre-transform substitutes mutated production source copied under /tmp in memory. Each targeted case executes and fails an assertion; no loader failure is counted. Tracked production bytes are never written.
